name: Sairaj Bandre
pitch: I spent a year building the automation behind real e-commerce operations. Now I'm in Dublin doing an MSc and turning that into AI engineering, shipping one project at a time with Claude Code as my pair-programmer.
summary: AI-focused Computer Science postgraduate (B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science) with hands-on experience building AI agent workflows, automation and data pipelines in production, plus deep learning, computer vision and NLP projects. Two published research papers.

story: I started out at Ergode, an e-commerce company, first as an AI intern and then running supply-chain automation. The work was practical: orders flowing through Walmart DSV and Shein portals, Amazon Seller Central workflows the API didn't cover, reports nobody wanted to build by hand. I built the bots, pipelines and n8n agent workflows that did it instead.

That job taught me the part of AI that demos skip: data is messy, systems break in ways nobody planned for, and a tool only counts if people actually use it. I moved to Dublin for an MSc in Computer Science at UCD to go deeper on the models themselves.

Now I'm building towards an AI engineering role in public: text-to-SQL agents, supply-chain risk models, evaluation harnesses. Every project ships on GitHub with honest numbers, including the ones that didn't work.
about.aside: Off the keyboard I'm usually looking up. I'm a plane-spotter with Flightradar open far more than I'd like to admit, which is how a 3D plane-tracking app ended up in this portfolio.

loop.body: Pick one concept I can't explain yet: schema linking, SHAP, tool-calling loops.
Build something real with it, with Claude Code as pair-programmer and me owning the decisions.
Push it to GitHub with tests, a write-up and the numbers, good or bad.

experience.role: Executive, Supply Chain Management & Automation Operations
points: Built and owned live automation systems processing high-volume orders across multiple seller portals (Walmart DSV, Shein), improving accuracy, throughput and reliability.
Developed automated data pipelines and SQL reporting tools that turned operational data into actionable insight on shipping variance and shipper performance.
Solved a hard integration gap by building RPA-driven automation for Amazon Seller Central workflows not covered by the SP-API, removing manual handling of high-volume processes.
Debugged, optimised and scaled automation systems with cross-functional teams, quickly learning unfamiliar codebases to improve reliability and performance.
Designed and deployed AI agent workflows using n8n to automate tasks across departments, turning stakeholder requirements into working, maintainable tools.
Built automated report generation from databases and Excel, delivering accurate, timely output to support data-driven decisions.
Implemented RPA tools to eliminate repetitive manual tasks, improving data quality and saving employee time.

education.note: Current. Includes the Text Analytics module.
Two published research papers from undergraduate projects.
